offering_description.value: Sells furniture and other bulky goods to retailers and resellers through an online wholesale marketplace that also connects them with third-party manufacturers. It provides warehousing, fulfillment and delivery, sells goods to consumers through third-party retail sites, and offers catalog software to furniture retailers.

primary_products.value: indoor furniture; outdoor furniture; home appliances; fitness equipment; retail catalog and digital signage software

primary_services.value: wholesale marketplace access; freight coordination; warehousing; order fulfillment; last-mile delivery

customer_segment.value: B2B: furniture manufacturers, wholesalers, online resellers and brick-and-mortar retailers; B2C: households buying furniture and other bulky goods through online retailers

end_markets.value: home furnishings; home appliances; fitness equipment; e-commerce and specialty retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: company-owned inventory sold to resellers and consumers; service fees: freight, storage, fulfillment and delivery of bulky goods; transaction or usage fees: fees on third-party marketplace orders; subscription: cloud-based product catalogs and digital signage for retailers
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; transaction or usage fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: distributor: sources bulky goods from manufacturers and supplies retailers and resellers; software / platform: hosts supplier listings for wholesale buyers and provides digital catalogs to furniture stores; service provider: stores, fulfills and ships bulky orders for suppliers and retailers; retailer: sells sourced furnishings and other bulky goods to consumers through third-party sites
value_chain_position.category: distributor; software / platform; service provider; retailer

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, United Kingdom, continental Europe and Asia, including Japan and China

specialization.value: related lines: bulky-goods wholesale, online retail, fulfillment and furniture retail software

distribution_channels.value: online: company-operated wholesale marketplace for retailers and resellers; third-party retail: online retail marketplaces serving consumers; direct sales: wholesale relationships and retail software sales to furniture stores

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: cross-border customs and import rules, consumer product safety standards, and warehouse and freight safety rules

notes: The current country-by-country footprint and scope of direct wholesale sales are uncertain.
